# CSS Motion Lab

> A dependency-free collection of copyable HTML and CSS motion studies.

## Effects

- Folder Pocket: layered documents and a restrained 3D pocket opening.
- Value Card Fan: overlapping cards that part around the active card.
- Document Folder: a hover-driven archive that opens, raises its collection, and fans the rear document.
- Glass Theme Switcher: a native light and dark switch with one moving glass lens and synchronized warm indicator.
- Task Progress Pills: three independent animated values with colored fields and fluid SVG frontiers.
- Liquid Refraction Lens: a draggable CSS and SVG glass capsule that displaces the pixels behind it.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/virgoone/css-motion-lab)
- [Live website](https://motion-css.douni.one/)
